item.title: North Korean hackers using QR codes to attack governments and think tanks: FBI
item.description: The FBI has warned that a North Korean cybercrime group known for its prolific espionage operations is using QR codes to launch spear-phishing attacks against U.S. and foreign government entities and other institutions.
